narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To explain a recent scientific discovery regarding the genetic ancestry of Papua New Guineans. The video uses AI-driven research to debunk the theory of an early 'pioneer' migration group and proves they share a closer lineage with East Asians than previously thought based on appearance.
